shortDesc.message: Save any image as PNG, JPG, WebP, AVIF or PDF — real conversion, highest resolution, 100% local.

storeDesc.message:
Save Image As turns Chrome's right-click menu into a real image converter — no uploads, no extra apps, no guessing whether the file will actually open.

Right-click any picture on any website and pick the format you need. The image is decoded and re-encoded right there in your browser, so what you get is a genuine, correctly-formatted file — not just the original bytes with a new file extension slapped on.

⚙️ Supported output formats:
- save as png – lossless quality, keeps transparency, the right choice for logos, graphics and screenshots
- save as jpg – smaller file size, ideal for photos, sharing and email attachments
- save as webp – modern compression with excellent visual quality at a fraction of the size
- save as avif – next-generation format for the smallest file size available today
- save as pdf – turn any picture into a print-ready, shareable PDF document
- save original – download the exact file as-is, no conversion, when the source format is already what you need

⚡ One click, every time
Pick your favorite format and folder once in the popup. After that, the right-click menu shows a single "Save as [format]" shortcut that saves instantly — no save dialog, no digging through a submenu, no repeating the same choice image after image.

📐 Gets the real image, not the thumbnail
Modern pages load an image several different ways — srcset, picture elements, a small preview linked to a larger original. Save Image As checks all of them and saves the highest-resolution version actually available, instead of whatever thumbnail happened to load first.

🔒 100% local, private by design
Every conversion happens directly on your device. Images are never uploaded, never sent to any server, and never seen by us. No accounts, no sign-up, no ads, no tracking.

🧩 Minimal permissions, explained in plain English
Save Image As only ever reads the image you right-click, on the page you're using it on. Nothing is requested "just in case" — every permission the extension asks for is explained on its own settings page.

Whether you're converting webp to jpg, saving a picture as png, turning an image into a pdf, or just trying to get a photo off a page in full resolution instead of a blurry thumbnail, Save Image As does it in one right-click. Free, private and reliable.
